description_zh: 一辆重型卡车（ego）在 Randall Street 上向东南直行，遇对向车道静止的 Waymo AV（v2）让行，卡车经过时左侧与 AV 左后传感器发生侧擦碰撞。判定 ego 为卡车，因其具有主动驾驶决策（通过静止车辆），NPC 静止在对向车道。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was proceeding northwest on Randall Street near the intersection with Harper Street when it came to a stop to yield to a heavy truck traveling southeast on Randall Street.
As the heavy truck drove past the Waymo AV, the driver’s side section of the heavy truck made contact with the rear driver’s side sensor of the Waymo AV.
evidence.reason: 重型卡车（移动车辆）作为 ego，Waymo AV 静止在对向车道，侧擦碰撞可用 oncoming + static_hold 表达，lateral 设 0.1 模拟传感器接触。
